recommendation: Keep the commit. It aligns active example guidance with the current R6 model while preserving the original ability to represent multiple period maximums. Do not restore the old denominator wording unless Pharmacy separately decides to constrain duplicate DosageSafety.doseLimit periods.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue asking how to represent multiple maximum doses per period, resolved for R5 by making Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod repeatable and adding denominator guidance.

additional_context: The current R6 source has since adopted the FHIR-51540 DosageDetails/DosageSafety refactor. DosageSafety.doseLimit is repeatable, has a required scope, and uses doseLimit.period for period-scoped limits; dosage narrative says multiple limits are supported. Example 2 still referenced the removed Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod element and old asNeededBoolean name.
reconciliation: Updated source/dosage-examples.html so Example 2 uses Dosage.asNeeded and only the current MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.safety.doseLimit period-limit guidance for the 150 mg/week cap.
source_changes: source/dosage-examples.html: removed the obsolete Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod bullet from Example 2 and updated the adjacent PRN field name from Dosage.asNeededBoolean to Dosage.asNeeded.
